gameName: Detective: A Modern Crime Board Game

modules.name: L.A. Crimes (3 cases, new board and investigators)

steps.text: Board in reach; Investigation Team marker on Headquarters
L.A. Crimes board (usual Time track side for cases 1-2, other side for case 3); IT marker on the Police Station, your new Headquarters
steps.ref: Detective: L.A. Crimes rulebook (Portal Games) p.1-2

steps.text: Set aside the Technology Skill tokens (a Wild token can stand in for Research, Questioning or Perception)
steps.ref: Detective: L.A. Crimes rulebook (Portal Games) p.1

steps.text: Time marker on 8:00 AM, Day marker on day 1
Each player picks an investigator tile (L.A. Crimes: its own tiles), faceup, and takes the Skill token shown bottom right
Unused tiles go Consultant side up; take their Skill tokens too
All those Skill tokens form the shared Token pool
Log in at antaresdatabase.com and choose the campaign and case
Case deck beside the board; read the casebook introduction, special rules and setup changes
L.A. Crimes case deck beside the board; the case introduction is on the Antares website (no casebook)
steps.ref: Detective: L.A. Crimes rulebook (Portal Games) p.1

steps.text: Room for notes or a mind map, and a browser in reach
Jack Coleman, former cop
details: Reports: Write a report gives 2 Authority instead of 1

steps.text: Chris Stone, former private eye
details: Second look: pay 1 Authority and the Skill token to Dig Deeper on an already resolved lead

steps.text: Ben Harris, former FBI analyst
details: Analysis: pay 2 Skill tokens to gain 1 Authority

steps.text: Julia Jacobson, former investigative journalist
details: Sources: pay 1 Skill token to turn another Skill token in the pool into 1 Authority

steps.text: Mia Roberts, former psychologist
details: Support: pay 1 Authority to remove another investigator's Used Ability token

steps.text: Each ability once per day: mark it with a Used Ability token; clear them at day's end
Leads in another Location: move the IT marker there and advance Time 1 hour
Each hour after 4:00 PM adds 1 Stress; reaching the case's Stress limit ends the investigation
A drawn lead must be resolved; no peeking at its cost first
Plot cards go unread into the bag of the case they name
L.A. Crimes: Write a report only at the Police Station; new actions on cards: take Stress, decide now, assign surveillance
steps.ref: Detective: L.A. Crimes rulebook (Portal Games) p.1-2

steps.text: Easier: 3 extra stress-free hours on the last day; harder: last day 2 hours shorter
steps.ref: Detective: L.A. Crimes rulebook (Portal Games) p.3

steps.text: Pick a lead from the casebook's Further Leads and start the day at Headquarters
